AKRE_HOME.text: Akre Focus ETF Fund Summary About Akre Investment Process Our Thinking Our Team Press Documents Contact Us Individual Investors Financial Professionals Media Relations Menu Fund Summary About Akre Investment Process Our Thinking Our Team Press Documents Contact Us Individual Investors Financial Professionals Media Relations Search Search The Akre Focus ETF: Now Trading on NYSE Arca As of October 27, 2025, Akre Capital has completed the conversion of the Akre Focus Fund to the Akre Focus ETF (ticker "AKRE"), one of the industry's largest single mutual fund-to-ETF conversions. The ETF is managed by the same investment team and continues to be guided by Akre Capital's “Three-Legged Stool” investment approach. The ETF structure delivers a more cost-effective, tax-efficient, and transparent vehicle for current and future shareholders.
